main.notes: Main config (same file as /sdcard/Android/data/com.retroarch/files/retroarch.cfg). Every setting is written on save. Values are written double-quoted: key = "value"; the raw values below are the text inside the quotes. Contains secrets (cheevos_*, netplay_*): never print.

global_core_options.notes: Only used when global_core_options = "true", or to seed a missing per-core .opt. core_options_path moves it.

opt_mupen64plus.notes: Per-core options for mupen64plus_next_gles3_libretro_android.so (library_name "Mupen64Plus-Next"). RetroArch creates it when the core first unloads.

opt_genesis_plus_gx.notes: Per-core options for genesis_plus_gx_libretro_android.so (library_name "Genesis Plus GX"). RetroArch creates the folder and .opt when the core first unloads.

opt_snes9x.notes: Per-core options for snes9x_libretro_android.so (library_name "Snes9x"). RetroArch creates the folder and .opt when the core first unloads.

override_core_flycast.notes: Flycast core override; holds only the keys it changes. Pattern: config/<core>/<core>.cfg.

shader_presets.notes: Auto-loaded shader presets (auto_shaders_enable). Each holds one #reference "<path to .slangp>" line. Shaders live in /data/user/0/com.retroarch/shaders/shaders_slang (Vulkan) and shaders_glsl (GL).

standalone_gambatte_cfg.notes: A full config in the config root, when one has been saved. Not an override path RetroArch loads automatically (overrides live in config/<core>/); it is what "Save New Configuration" writes. Only used if something launches RetroArch with it as the config file. Not checked whether Cocoon does.

per_game.game_id: {game} = content file name without directory and extension (path_basename_nocompression of the loaded ROM, e.g. "Some Game (USA)"). {core} = the core's library_name, which is the folder name under config/: Beetle Saturn, Mupen64Plus-Next, mGBA, Gambatte, Flycast, Genesis Plus GX, Snes9x.
per_game.notes: Settings overrides (auto_overrides_enable = "true"): config/{core}/{core}.cfg, then config/{core}/{contentdir}.cfg ({contentdir} = name of the ROM's parent folder), then config/{core}/{game}.cfg, each stacked on retroarch.cfg; later wins. An override holds only the keys it changes. Core options do NOT stack: RetroArch uses exactly one file, the first that exists of config/{core}/{game}.opt, config/{core}/{contentdir}.opt (both need game_specific_options = "true"), config/{core}/{core}.opt, and finally retroarch-core-options.cfg (global_core_options, or to seed a new per-core file). A per-game .opt must therefore contain every option the game needs, not just the changed one: copy the core .opt and edit it. Shader presets: config/{core}/{game}.slangp > {contentdir}.slangp > {core}.slangp > global.slangp. Remaps: config/remaps/{core}/{game}.rmp etc..

video_driver.label: Video (Drivers > Video)
video_driver.notes: Android default is gl (configuration.c VIDEO_DEFAULT_DRIVER: HAVE_OPENGL). Can be set in a core override; driver reinits on content load.

values.true: render on a separate thread (smoother, more latency)

swap_interval.label: VSync Swap Interval
swap_interval.notes: Range 0-4; 0 shows as "Auto" (factor from core-reported rate).

values.<0-99>: milliseconds to wait after vsync before running the core

aspect_ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.notes: enum aspect_ratio (gfx/video_defines.h); index 10 is named ASPECT_RATIO_4_4 in the enum but its table entry is "9:16". Default ASPECT_RATIO_CORE on Android.

shaders_enable.label: Video Shaders
shaders_enable.notes: Preset choice is not a retroarch.cfg key: it comes from the auto-load preset files (see files.shader_presets).

runahead.label: Run-Ahead (Single/Second Instance)
runahead.notes: Menu "Run-Ahead" mode = run_ahead_enabled + run_ahead_secondary_instance + preemptive_frames_enable: Off = all false; Single Instance = enabled true, secondary false; Second Instance = enabled true, secondary true; Preemptive Frames = preemptive true, enabled false.

values.<1-12>: frames (MAX_RUNAHEAD_FRAMES 12); also the preemptive frame count

menu_driver.label: Menu (Drivers > Menu)
menu_driver.notes: Android default is glui (MENU_MATERIALUI, RARCH_MOBILE). Restart RetroArch to apply.

values.true: load auto state on content start

overlay_enable.label: Display Overlay
overlay_enable.notes: Default comes from config_overlay_enable_default() (true on Android).

swap_ok_cancel.label: Menu Swap OK and Cancel Buttons

values.true: write retroarch.cfg from memory on Quit

network_cmd_enable.label: Network Commands
network_cmd_enable.notes: Read at start-up; restart RetroArch after changing.
